node.statement: Let {U_i} be any open cover of |K|. Because h is a homeomorphism, each h(U_i) is open in M and these images cover M. Compactness of M gives indices i_1,...,i_n with M = h(U_i_1) union ... union h(U_i_n). Applying h^{-1} gives |K| = U_i_1 union ... union U_i_n. Thus every open cover of |K| has a finite subcover, which is compactness.
